page.layout: One page of text, centred on the left printed page; a woodcut ornament below the text; faint show-through from the reverse page in the right-hand area, not transcribed.

main_text.p: ũm ædificatio, & eximiæ virtutis tuæ, quam hæc regio tota & circumstantes maximam sentiunt, maximo bono publico & suo, commendationem.

Deus te, Vir Nobilissime atque Amplissime, ab omni malo defendat, bonis augeat, consiliaque omnia & labores summos tuos secundet gratiose ad gloriam nominis sui, & salutem publicam Ecclesiæ suæ & florentissimæ vestræ totius Reipub. Lugduno Batavorum ipsis Kal. Februarii MDCII.

page.notes: The date line is set in spaced capitals with Roman numerals printed as "CIↃ. IↃCII." (MDCII). A woodcut ornament (mask within scrolls) stands below the text and is not transcribed. Show-through from the facing page is ignored. Printed text is only partly legible in the scan; the date is read as "CIↃ. IↃCII." and the transcription follows that reading.
